articles.summary: “Your electricity will be disconnected today. Pay ₦50,000 now.” Sounds scary, right? That sense of urgency is exactly what electricity scammers rely on. From fake DisCo officials to fraudulent payment links and “cheap token” offers, electricity scams in Nigeria can take many forms. Knowing the red flags can help
articles.title: Electricity Scams: 7 Scams to Watch Out For
